name: prompt_v2
description: Improved support prompt that preserves concrete policy details and escalation channels.
system_prompt: Answer with concrete policy details and operational next steps.

answer_overrides.refund_policy: Starter customers can request a refund within 14 days of purchase. Ask them to contact support@acme.test so the billing team can process it.
answer_overrides.sla_enterprise: Enterprise customers receive a four-hour first-response SLA and a dedicated Slack escalation channel for urgent incidents.
answer_overrides.seat_upgrade: They can add seats immediately from billing settings, and the extra seats will be prorated for the remainder of the billing period.
answer_overrides.data_residency: Today the default hosting region is the US. EU data residency is on the roadmap, but it is not generally available yet.
